annotations.description:
Disk space on volume {{ $labels.volume }} of host {{ $labels.instance }} is critically low, with {{ printf "%.2f" $value }}% of total space used.
This exceeds the threshold of 90%.
Current disk free: {{ with printf `windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{volume="%s", job=~"integrations/windows_exporter"}` $labels.volume | query | first | value | humanize }}{{ . }}{{ end }}.
Total disk size: {{ with printf `windows_logical_disk_size_bytes{volume="%s", job=~"integrations/windows_exporter"}` $labels.volume | query | first | value | humanize }}{{ . }}{{ end }}.
Consider cleaning up unnecessary files or increasing disk capacity.
annotations.summary: Disk is almost full on Windows host.
